title: 喜欢 + verb: like doing
summary: Lets you say what you like or like doing, as in 我喜欢看书.
explanation:
喜欢 means 'to like'. It takes a thing (我喜欢猫 'I like cats') or an action (我喜欢看书 'I like reading'). There is no '-ing' in Chinese: just put the verb straight after 喜欢.

To make it stronger, use 很 or 非常: 我很喜欢喝茶. The negative is 不喜欢. To ask, add 吗 or use 喜欢不喜欢.

examples.en: My dad doesn't like watching films.

mistakes.why: 很 goes before 喜欢, not before the action.
Don't put 吗 inside the sentence; a statement needs no 吗.

why: Correct: 喜欢 + verb, nothing in between.
No 的 is needed after the action.
很 goes before 喜欢, not before 做饭.

exercises.en: My older sister really likes cats.

why: Likes and dislikes take 不, not 没.
喜欢不下雨 means 'likes it not raining'.

exercises.prompt: Which asks 'Do you like Chinese food?'
why: 吗 goes at the end, after the object.
This mixes 吗 and 吧 and has the wrong order.
Correct: 非常 + 喜欢 = 'love, like very much'.
是 doesn't go before 喜欢.
在 here would need a place and doesn't strengthen 喜欢.
了吗 doesn't belong in this statement.
The person (我) comes before 喜欢.
